name: Karen Palacios
description: Hi, I’m Karen, and no, I’m not like the other Karens... I’m from the heart of Mexico, Guanajuato. My life is a fiesta of words and culture, and even though my journey into teaching Spanish didn’t start in a traditional classroom, my experience is as colorful and diverse as our rich language. I’m as social as a party in a main square in Mexico, always ready to connect and create bonds that enrich the soul.

My name is NABEH. I have a BA in Islamic Studies.
And I am currently studying a master degree in the Faculty of Arabic Language and Literature.

name: Maylis Q.
description:
Hi ! 
My name is Maylis, and I'm passionnate about literature,arts and social sciences. 
I am of course open to discuss any topic in our classes.
I teach as a private tutor since five years now, since i graduated from university. I have a master's degree in literature and how to teach french as a secondary language.I design my class for each student, so learning french will not be a chore for you. I use your passions, hobbies, center of interest to build the lessons.

name: Güney S.
description: Hello There! I'm Güney, an experienced online Turkish teacher. My aim is to enable students from all over the world to speak Turkish fluently and confidently.I have been giving online Turkish lessons to students of various levels for years. With conversation practice-oriented and personalized lessons, my goal is for you to progress quickly. While strengthening your grammar fundamentals, I also work on improving your pronunciation.I believe in making learning enjoyable. In my lessons, I use interactive materials and real-life scenarios. I provide a respectful and supportive environment that considers different cultures and learning styles.You are in the right place to learn Turkish. I am here to help you achieve your goals. I look forward to meeting you in your first online lesson!

name: Rita Sofia L.
description: Hello! My name is Rita, I'm Portuguese, born and raised in the south of Portugal ☀️I'm passionate about languages, people, and travel. I lived in France for 9 years, and now I dedicate myself to teaching my mother tongue with a simple, practical, and welcoming method.I offer Portuguese classes for foreigners, from level A1 (beginners) to conversation. I adapt to your pace, your needs, and your personal or professional goals. I prepare the materials with great care, explain patiently, and always give light tasks to help consolidate what we've learned.If you want to learn Portuguese naturally, with a teacher who loves to teach, book a lesson with me. It will be a pleasure to help you on this linguistic journey.I have informal experience teaching Portuguese, both by supporting foreign friends who were adapting to life in Portugal and through private tutoring, where I helped students significantly improve their academic performance. I enjoy tailoring the teaching to each person's needs in a simple and practical way.Learning Portuguese can be an incredible adventure! I'm here to make that journey light and fun. Let's go together!
shortBio: Speak like a local from Lisbon!

name: Nayeon J.
description:
Hello 
 I'm Nayeon from South Korea 
 I'm living in Seoul now.
 I really love to talk with people from various countries because everyone is different ! My goal is being helpful for people who are interested in Korean and South Korea I've taught a lot of exchange students who came to Korea for learning my country's language and culture ! You can learn korean easily with various subjects like k-beauty, k-pop, k-drama, k-food etc which are well planned 
If you have plans to visit Korea, you can also learn Surviving Korean and I'll recommend you the places you must visit, foods you must try etc. :)Book a trial lesson with me so we can talk about your goals and discuss how can we reach there together 🤩
shortBio: Fun lessons using drama and K-pop!

name: Ilaria O.
description: Hi!My name is Ilaria, I'm from Turin but I live in Rome, and I have been a private teacher for many years now: for more than 10 years I have been helping Italian students to learn English and German (I have graduated in Foreign Languages and I'm a translator) and for about 4 years I have been helping foreign students to learn Italian, which is my mother tongue. I work both in presence and online, and thanks to the Internet I can teach students from all around the world.

name: Rina Y.
description: Namaste! 🙏I'm Rina, a dedicated Hindi teacher from India with a deep love for the language. I completed my Msc in Zoology from CCS University, Meerut. I Completed my BEd from MDU University Haryana . I qualified CTET and UPTET also.With 6 years of experience teaching at Star Public School and Sainik Children Academy, and 12 years as a home tutor, I customize, adapt, and mold my classes according to the specific needs and goals of my students. I also provide teaching materials like worksheets, practice sheets, and videos after lessons.Learning a new language can be an exciting adventure, and I'm here to be your trusted companion on this path. Together, we'll explore Hindi's grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and cultural nuances. With a personalized approach to teaching, book a trial lesson with me so we can discuss your needs and goals. Learning Hindi with me will be an interesting and meaningful experience!
